verses.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: This shall be the law for the sick person on the day of his purification and when he comes before the priest.
verses.3: And the priest went out to the outside of the camp. There, he saw that the sick man had been healed; the disease had left him.
verses.4: And the priest commanded that two clean birds be taken for purification. They were to be clean birds, along with an oak tree and two spoons.
verses.5: And the priest commanded that one of the hairs be cut off, and it should be thrown into the waters of life.
verses.6: She will take the living tree, along with the olive tree and the second staff. She will then soak them in the blood of the sacrificed animal. The living tree will be placed in the waters of life.
verses.7: And he cleansed it from the corruption seven times. Then he sent the living dove before the altar.
verses.8: And he would wash his clothes, shave off all his hair, and bathe in the water. After that, he would go to the camp and sit outside his tent for seven days.
verses.9: And on the seventh day, he shall shave off all his hair from his head, from his beard, and from the tops of his eyes. He shall also shave off all his hair and wash his clothes in water, so that he may be cleansed.
verses.10: And on the eighth day, he shall take two clean containers. Also, one clean container for the year. And three dozen pieces of bread to be used as offerings. All these items should be prepared in the smoke and with one log of wood.
verses.11: And the priest, who had been purified, stood before Jehovah, at the entrance to the Tabernacle.
verses.12: And the priest took one of the loaves and offered it to Ashem. He also offered the wood of the altar, and he placed them in the ark before Jehovah.
verses.13: And he shall slaughter the goat at the place where the sin and the guilt are to be sacrificed. For the sin of the priest is holy, just as the goat itself is also holy.
verses.14: And the priest took some blood from the wound; then he applied that blood to the tip of his right ear, as well as to the back of his right hand and the back of his right foot.
verses.15: And the priest took some oil from the lampstand, and poured it on the forehead of the priest.
verses.16: And the priest shall dip his right hand into the oil that is on the altar. Then he shall put that oil on the head of the lamb before Jehovah seven times.
verses.17: And the oil that is applied to the head by the priest, it is applied to the forehead, as well as to the palms of his hands and feet. This oil is used to cover the blood from the wound.
verses.18: And the incense that is on the priest’s arm shall be placed on the head of the one being cleansed. Then the priest shall sprinkle it before Jehovah.
verses.19: And the priest shall do what is wrong, and cover the altar with his own blood. Then he shall slaughter the lamb.
verses.20: And the priest raised up the altar and the incense offering. Then the priest covered it with a covering, and it became holy.
verses.21: And if he is poor and his hands are unable to work, then take one piece of bread and wrap it in cloth. Use this to wrap around his head. And also take twenty pieces of cheese, and wrap them in cloth as well.
verses.22: And two sons of Yonah, who will extend their hands. One will be a sinner, and the other will be righteous.
verses.23: And on the eighth day, he brought them before the priest at the entrance to the tabernacle, in order to be purified before Jehovah.
verses.24: And the priest took the burning stick and the lampstand, and he held them up before Jehovah.
verses.25: And he slaughtered the ram as an offering. Then the priest took some of the blood from the ram and applied it to the tip of his right ear, and also to the back of his right hand and the back of his right foot.
verses.26: And from the smoke, the priest poured it onto the palm of his hand.
verses.27: And this priest stood with his right hand on the shoulder of the Semitic man who was before Jehovah. This happened seven times.
verses.28: And the priest shall put the incense on the altar, on the fire that is used for purification. He shall also place his hand on the fire, and his foot on the same place where the blood of the sacrifice was placed.
verses.29: And the smoke that rises from the priest’s staff shall be placed on the head of the one being purified, before Jehovah.
verses.30: And he made one of those creatures, or one of the children of the sun, so that it could stretch out its hands.
verses.31: That one who touches the one who is unclean, and that one who stands on the altar. And the priest stands over the one who is to be cleansed before Jehovah.
verses.32: This is the law according to which one who is defiled cannot have his hands clean.
verses.33: And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
verses.34: For you shall come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you as possession. And I will place a sign in the house of your possession.
verses.35: And when he came into the house, he said to the priest, “It seems to me that there’s something strange in this house.”
verses.36: And the priest commanded that the house be cleaned before he came to see the mark. He ordered that nothing in the house should be touched. Only after that did the priest come to examine the house.
verses.37: And he saw the marks left by the wounds on the walls of the house. These marks were covered with greenish or brownish substances. Their appearance was very unpleasant compared to the color of the walls themselves.
verses.38: And the priest went out from the house to the door of the house, and sealed the house for seven days.
verses.39: And on the seventh day, the priest stood up and saw that the mark where it had touched the walls of the house had become healed.
verses.40: And the priest commanded that the stones on which the disease had occurred be removed, and they were thrown out into the outside of the city, to a place that was filthy.
verses.41: And they measured out the courtyard from the surrounding rooms. They poured out the water that had been allocated for use outside the city, into a place that was considered unclean.
verses.42: And they took other stones, and brought them under the stones. Then another man took a shovel and scooped the earth out from beneath the stones.
verses.43: And if the damaged part returns to health and blooms in the house, after removing the stones from it, and after finishing the construction of the house, and after completing the rest of the work.
verses.44: And the priest came and saw that the place where the skin was touched in the house was covered with a black stain. It was a filthy place.
verses.45: And he destroyed the house, along with its stones and branches. He also removed all the plants growing inside the house, and he threw them out into the outside of the city, to a dirty place.
verses.46: And every day, when he was locked up in the house, he would be exposed to the sun until dawn.
verses.47: And those who sleep in the house will take their clothes with them. And those who eat in the house will also take their clothes with them.
verses.48: And if the priest comes and sees that the sore on the house has not been healed after he has cleansed the house, then the priest must clean the house again, because the sore has been healed.
verses.49: And he took for his “sin” two cypress trees, an oak tree, and two thorns.
verses.50: And he slaughtered the other bird over the entire herd on the waters of life.
verses.51: And he took the acacia tree, as well as the olive branch and the other two branches. He immersed them in the blood of the living creatures, and also in the waters of life. Then he placed them in the temple seven times.
verses.52: And he polluted the house with the blood of the silkworms, with living water, and with the blood of the silkworms themselves. He also polluted the tree of life, as well as the other trees.
verses.53: And send the living serpent out into the outskirts of the city, over the edge of the field. Let it cover the house and destroy everything in its path.
verses.54: This is the Torah for all those who are afflicted and suffering.
verses.55: And for the sake of the garment and the loincloth.
verses.56: And to lift and to carry away, and to carry on one’s shoulders.
verses.57: On the day of impurity and on the day of purification, this is the law regarding the tzaraat.
